mira: quick flag — ran an ad-hoc scan and found ~8 principals with 'admin' entitlements but no owner in our inventory (last seen >90d). attaching the short output.

mira: ```
PRINCIPAL             ROLE        LAST_ACTIVE   OWNER
svc-analytics-ops     admin       2025-09-03    <none>
svc-deploy-canary     admin       2025-07-18    <none>
user:ci-bot            admin       2025-04-02    <none>
svc-legacy-migrate    admin       2024-11-29    <none>
svc-experiments       admin       2024-10-10    <none>
svc-ml-backup         admin       2025-01-15    <none>
svc-sandbox-proxy     admin       2023-08-20    <none>
svc-internal-tools    admin       2025-02-02    <none>
```

mira: query used: `rbac-scan --age 90d --role admin --include-unused --format table`

alex: :eyes: thanks for catching. can you paste the audit-log correlation for svc-analytics-ops? want to confirm no recent token usage or KMS grants before we touch anything.

mira: grabbing logs now. quick snippet for svc-analytics-ops:

mira: ```
2025-09-03T14:12Z  iam.grant KMS:decrypt principal=svc-analytics-ops key=projects/redwood/kms/keys/etl-key
2025-06-01T09:05Z  auth.token_issued principal=svc-analytics-ops
(no interactive sessions since 2025-06)
```

rene: fwiw, that pattern looks like a long-lived service principal used only by an old ETL job. risk level medium since it still has KMS decrypt. suggest we follow the standard owner-outreach -> staged-disable -> rotate-keys runbook.

rene: runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/security/ownerless-privs

alex: agree with staged approach. propose a short canary in staging: mark svc-analytics-ops as "staging-disabled" tag and run the ETL smoke tests. if nothing breaks for 48h, proceed to prod notification window.

ben: +1 and assign to security for owner outreach. also we should add these principals to this quarter's access review (sys-admins bucket). please create an action item in the access-review board.

mira: created ticket: SEC-4212 "orphan-admins: initial outreach and canary"; assigning to @rene and @alex. ETA for initial outreach: tomorrow EOD.

sre-bot: scheduled job triggered: `audit-sweep-ephemeral-privs` started 2025-09-04T02:00Z — results will be posted to #eng-security.

alex: one more ask — can infra run `kms-grant-check --principals svc-* --since 2024-01-01` and dump grants to the ticket? want to be safe about cross-project binds.

rene: on it. will post results in SEC-4212 and tag ops. planning a staging prune next week; will include rollback steps in the ticket.

mira: action items:
- owner outreach messages (2 business days) @rene
- canary disable in staging + smoke tests @alex
- kms-grant inventory and rotate suggestions @rene
- add principals to quarterly access review @ben

ben: please mark TODOs in SEC-4212 and add a follow-up for post-prune audit in 7 days. thanks :thumbsup:

alex: ok queued. if anyone sees unexpected alerts from monitors during the canary, ping #eng-oncall and i'll pause the rollout.

mira: noted. I'll watch audit stream and post any anomalies here. :eyes:

sre-bot: audit-sweep-ephemeral-privs completed: 8 flagged principals, details in SEC-4212.
